points.statement: The proposed rectification network targets all-in-one image restoration to mitigate the characterized dual-ambiguity issue.
points.quote: To mitigate this issue, we propose DAR-Net, a Dual-Ambiguity Rectification Network for all-in-one image restoration.

points.statement: A representation module constructs a structured degradation state through simplex-constrained archetype mixture modeling.
points.quote: DAR-Net first introduces a Degradation Archetype Representation (DAR) module to construct a structured degradation state through simplex-constrained archetype mixture modeling.

points.statement: A rectification module uses that state to generate degradation-aware prompts that improve channel-wise conditioning in the decoder.
points.quote: Based on this state, a Semantic Ambiguity Rectification (SeAR) module generates degradation-aware prompts to improve channel-wise conditioning in the decoder.

points.statement: A rectification module regularizes degradation-aware and complementary features toward orthogonal response subspaces, reducing spatial interference between removal and preservation cues.
points.quote: A Spatial Ambiguity Rectification (SpAR) module further regularizes degradation-aware and complementary features toward orthogonal response subspaces, reducing spatial interference between removal and preservation cues.
